_meta.exclusion_set: 34 full exchange stop-outs (SL leg, initial bracket)
_meta.rule: zero SL inside, then most winners kept, then fewest variables; ties: tier sum, fewest early stops+non-SL losers kept, widest gap
_meta.bounds: lo/hi = midpoint between the nearest kept winner and the nearest excluded SL on that side; null = open (no SL on that side needs excluding)
_meta.missing_value_policy: REFUSE the entry if any box variable is missing at the decision
_meta.inclusive: a value equal to a bound is inside (bounds sit at midpoints, so no ledger trade sits on one)
_meta.status: IN-SAMPLE ONLY. Not validated out of sample. Prior: 22 in-sample entry rules on these 84 trades, 0 graded A/B out of sample (wc/ENTRY).
